.Server metrics
[cols="3m,1,2m,1,5",options="header"]
|===
| Name | Type | Labels | Phase 1 | Meaning
5+h| Process
| dsp_build_info | gauge | version, revision, backend | yes | Always 1. backend = io_uring \| epoll \| hello (Phase 1 placeholder).
| dsp_reactors | gauge | - | yes | Number of reactors (event loops, one per pinned core).
5+h| Connections
| dsp_connections_accepted_total | counter | reactor, transport | yes | Accepted connections. transport = tcp \| ws \| unix.
| dsp_connections_closed_total | counter | reactor, transport, reason | yes | Closed connections. reason = peer \| error \| protocol \| idle \| shutdown.
| dsp_connections_rejected_total | counter | reactor, transport, reason |  | Connections refused after accept. reason = limit \| handshake.
| dsp_connections | gauge | reactor, transport | yes | Open connections.
5+h| Traffic
| dsp_rx_bytes_total | counter | reactor, transport | yes | Bytes received from sockets (after TLS, if any).
| dsp_tx_bytes_total | counter | reactor, transport | yes | Bytes written to sockets.
| dsp_rx_messages_total | counter | reactor, transport, type | yes | Frames received. type = data \| echo_req \| req (doc/protocol.adoc).
| dsp_tx_messages_total | counter | reactor, transport, type | yes | Frames sent. type = echo_rsp \| rsp.
| dsp_protocol_errors_total | counter | reactor, transport, reason | yes | Malformed input; the connection is closed. reason = bad_magic \| bad_version \| too_large \| bad_type.
5+h| UDP
| dsp_udp_datagrams_total | counter | reactor, direction |  | UDP datagrams. direction = rx \| tx. A GRO/GSO super-datagram counts as its segments.
| dsp_udp_dropped_total | counter | reactor, reason |  | Datagrams dropped by the server. reason = truncated \| malformed \| no_buffer. Kernel drops: node-exporter.
5+h| Backpressure
| dsp_backpressure_events_total | counter | reactor |  | Times a connection stopped reading because its send queue crossed the high watermark.
| dsp_backpressure_seconds_total | counter | reactor |  | Connection-seconds spent with reading paused by backpressure.
| dsp_send_queue_bytes | gauge | reactor |  | Bytes queued for sending, summed over the reactor's connections.
5+h| Reactor
| dsp_loop_iterations_total | counter | reactor | yes | Event-loop iterations (one wait + processing of its completions/events).
| dsp_loop_busy_seconds_total | counter | reactor |  | Time the reactor spent outside the kernel wait; rate() is the reactor's utilisation (0..1).
| dsp_syscalls_total | counter | reactor, op |  | Syscalls issued by the reactor. op = io_uring_enter \| epoll_wait \| recv \| send \| accept \| other.
| dsp_io_uring_sqes_total | counter | reactor |  | Submission queue entries submitted (io_uring backend).
| dsp_io_uring_cqes_total | counter | reactor |  | Completion queue entries reaped (io_uring backend). cqes / io_uring_enter = batching factor.
| dsp_buffer_ring_empty_total | counter | reactor |  | Receives that found the provided buffer ring empty (ENOBUFS) and were re-armed.
| dsp_zerocopy_sends_total | counter | reactor, result |  | SEND_ZC operations. result = zerocopy \| copied (the kernel fell back to copying).
5+h| Memory
| dsp_buffer_bytes | gauge | reactor, kind |  | Memory held by buffers. kind = rx_ring \| rx_conn \| tx \| pool.
5+h| Latency
| dsp_handler_duration_seconds | histogram | reactor |  | Time spent in the handler per receive completion (all frames of one read).
| dsp_message_age_seconds | histogram | reactor |  | Receive time minus header ts_ns (one-way latency; meaningful with the sender on the same clock).
|===

.Load generator metrics
[cols="3m,1,2m,1,5",options="header"]
|===
| Name | Type | Labels | Phase 1 | Meaning
5+h| Load generator
| loadgen_build_info | gauge | version, revision | yes | Always 1.
| loadgen_connections | gauge | - | yes | Open connections.
| loadgen_connect_errors_total | counter | - | yes | Failed connection attempts.
| loadgen_tx_messages_total | counter | type | yes | Frames sent. type = data \| echo_req \| req.
| loadgen_tx_bytes_total | counter | - | yes | Bytes sent (headers included).
| loadgen_rx_messages_total | counter | - | yes | Reply frames received.
| loadgen_rx_bytes_total | counter | - | yes | Bytes received.
| loadgen_integrity_errors_total | counter | kind | yes | Reply sequence violations. kind = missing \| duplicate \| out_of_order \| corrupt.
| loadgen_rtt_seconds | histogram | - |  | Round trip from the intended send time to the reply (coordinated-omission safe in open-loop mode).
| loadgen_send_lag_seconds | histogram | - |  | Actual minus intended send time (open-loop). A growing lag means the generator or the network is saturated.
| loadgen_target_rate | gauge | - |  | Configured messages/s (0 = closed loop).
| loadgen_thread_busy_ratio | gauge | thread |  | Fraction of time each generator thread was busy (self-check: a run is invalid above 0.9).
